candidates.sentence: Randy is a strong fiscal conservative who fights for Iowa taxpayers and doesn’t support wasteful earmarks that fund liberal pet projects in New York and California.

Randy believes that we must deport illegal immigrants who break our laws and protect the American people from terrorists, drug traffickers, and criminals who are pouring over our border in record numbers.
Randy is a constitutional conservative who will always defend Iowans’ God-given, Second Amendment rights.

While China, Russia, North Korea, and Iran invest heavily in their military capabilities to destroy the United States, Randy will always vote to fund our troops and keep our military the strongest and most feared fighting force in the world.
He also supported legislation to defund Biden’s army of 87,000 new IRS agents, stop Biden’s unconstitutional student-loan bailouts, and end Biden’s electric-vehicle mandates on Iowa families.

Additionally, he voted for the REIN IN Inflation Act to cut inflation created by Biden’s wasteful spending agenda, the Middle Class Borrower Protection Act to repeal Biden’s tax on Iowans with strong credit scores to subsidize mortgages for those with low scores, and the REINS Act to remove power from unelected bureaucrats and end Biden’s reckless executive orders.

Randy strongly opposes the implementation of a central bank digital currency that would weaken the purchasing power of the American dollar and allow the federal government to easily track and monitor Americans’ financial transactions.
As a father of four and a Christian, Randy knows that we were all born to further God’s kingdom and believes that the unborn deserve to be protected from the liberal abortion-on-demand agenda.
Randy strongly opposes taxpayer-funded abortions, supports defunding Planned Parenthood, and has consistently voted against liberal attempts to legalize abortion until the moment of birth nationwide.
